acceptance_criteria.description: Agent Lens renders root, child, and nested descendants in stable hierarchy order with identity, role, distinct lifecycle/activity state, capability state, and result.
Selecting any descendant shows only that agent's complete bounded transcript and metadata after both live updates and journal restoration.
Follow-up/direct input, steer, interrupt, wait, inspect, and parent-mediated close affordances are present only when truthful and call the targeted normalized command path.
Tree keyboard navigation, screen-reader semantics, focus stability, restrained status announcements, disabled reasons, and 800 by 600 behavior have focused regression coverage.
Legacy root-only sessions and providers without subagent capability preserve existing Files, Commands, Timeline, launch, transcript, and resume behavior.
Focused store, selector, bus-connection, AgentTreeLens, and TerminalPanel suites plus the production frontend build pass with no out-of-scope changes.

closed_decisions: Add an Agents tab inside the existing Agent Lens alongside Files, Commands, and Timeline.
Use one accessible tree with role tree/treeitem, aria-level, aria-expanded, aria-selected, stable focus, and Up/Down/Left/Right/Home/End keyboard navigation.
Show a selected agent detail surface with identity, role, status, current activity, transcript, result, inherited runtime/model/reasoning metadata, and truthful capability-gated controls.
Preserve Tinto typography, density, color, and panel composition; use existing components and CSS tokens.
The frontend consumes the normalized additive contract and contains no Codex protocol parsing or provider-specific control branching.
Restored graphs remain fully inspectable even when no live process exists; mutating controls are disabled with factual reasons.
Parent-mediated close is labeled and dispatched through the existing root session path, never as archive or delete.

focused: npm test -- src/agent/sessionStore.test.ts src/agent/subagentSelectors.test.ts src/bus/contract.test.ts src/bus/connection.test.ts

forbidden_changes: Do not copy Codex desktop visual styling, replace Tinto's existing Agent Lens, redesign the session launcher, or add a generic provider UI framework.

Do not edit Rust, generated contracts, bus client infrastructure, dependencies, manifests, lockfiles, orchestration state, release artifacts, branches, commits, pushes, PRs, Jira, or files outside the owned list.
Do not show controls the normalized capability contract says are unavailable, report restored stale work as running, or use destructive archive/delete as close-agent behavior.
Do not truncate the persisted graph in selectors or flatten nested descendants into root transcript state.
objective: Add a native Tinto Agent Lens hierarchy that restores and exposes the complete Codex agent tree, per-agent transcript and result, truthful status and activity, and capability-gated controls with accessible keyboard behavior.
